content.short: Biswap is a low-fee DEX on the Binance Smart Chain with an AMM and liquidity pools.
content.description: Biswap is a decentralized exchange built on the Binance Smart Chain that uses an automated market maker (AMM) to enable token swaps with fees starting at 0.1%. Liquidity providers contribute by staking tokens in liquidity pools, and users can stake LP tokens to earn BSW tokens while supplying liquidity. The platform centers on low fees and a streamlined experience for swapping tokens and participating in liquidity provision. That design makes trading easy while giving liquidity providers ongoing earning opportunities.
